purpose: Author only self-contained, useful candidate edits with explicit reasoning and endings.
hard_gates: Meaning, source wording, standalone coherence, audience value and ending quality must pass.
An extracted opening must name the subject of the approved brief title.
soft_gates: Impact, insight, relevance, specificity, novelty and hook strength should justify production.

failure.fallback: Return a reject or rerecord diagnosis instead of manufacturing a publishable recommendation.

regression_cases: A stitched edit must make semantic sense as one complete argument.
A weak source yields rerecord guidance rather than content for content's sake.
An extracted candidate whose opening abandons the approved promise is blocked.
A short-native opening that drifts from the approved title is reported, not blocked, because its packaging is derived from the hook.
An opening that states no narrator standing, and a story past thirty seconds with no position marker, are both reported for review.
